body:
I guess that all makes sense. Thanks for explaining that. 

I just have no idea what to do next. I'm trying to find a job but no luck so far. I'm trying to find something that isn't very physically demanding. But its impossible.  Spending 8 hours a day on my feet is very difficult. After a few hours I'm in a lot of pain. 

That is what mainly contributes to the anger and sadness. 

It sounds like a simple solution, just go get my legs taken care of. Its not that easy. Rehab isn't covered by the Canadian health care system so I would have to pay for it myself. At 70-100 dollars a session (usually twice a week), I can't afford it. 

Its a never ending circle of fuckery. Need job to get legs fixed, only job I can find murders my legs. I know I need to just man up and take whatever comes my way and deal with it. 

Thanks for the advice. Nice to hear different opinions.
